messages:
maya: Heads up — CI just failed the multi-arch push for release/3.4.0. Deploybot says chunked upload aborted mid-manifest. Not a timeout, looks like a manifest hash mismatch for arm64.
sam: @maya can you paste the deploybot output?
maya: deploy-bot: push blocked for image redwood/realtime:3.4.0 - manifest exists with different platform list (sha256:aa11... vs new sha256:bb22...). upload interrupted at chunk 4/7.
liam: :eyes: that usually means one parallel CI runner pushed a partial manifest earlier. Could be a concurrent promote from staging.
eva: which registry? ecr or gcr?
maya: ECR eu-west-1. Trying to push from the build matrix on two runners (x86_64 + arm64).
sam: if manifest digest differs but layers same, we usually retag to the existing digest. But cosign attestation will not match the new tag unless we re-sign.
liam: we should avoid re-signing in the middle of a release. Option A: pin the deployment to the existing digest (sha256:aa11...) and proceed with release notes calling out digest pin. Option B: force retag and re-attest (longer).
maya: current release window is open for 2 more hours. We need a decision asap.
deploy-bot: automatic action: halted promotion to prod:3.4.0 due to manifest-digest-collision. Suggested action: pin-to-existing-digest or cancel-promotion. See <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ecr-manifest-collision>
eva: pin sounds safest to meet the window. We can create a follow-up to reconcile manifests and attestations in staging after the window.
sam: agree. How do we do the pin technically?
liam: update deploy manifest in k8s images to use redwood/realtime@sha256:aa11... instead of :3.4.0, then trigger deploybot promote with the pinned digest. Also update release notes and release page with the digest and note: "pinned; non-reproducible manifest collision prevented retag".
maya: I can patch the helm values and run the promote. I'll also add a short blurb to the release notes.
eva: will the client-side caching break if we pin? Any SDKs using semantic tag?
liam: no runtime change; :3.4.0 will still exist in some registries but for production we deploy by digest. SDKs that pull :3.4.0 may get either digest depending on which registry they hit — that's why we call out the digest in the release notes.
sam: create the rollback plan in case the pinned digest causes a runtime regression. 2 release managers should sign off.
maya: created a brief rollback checklist and added to the issue tracker: https://redwood.internal/issues/INFR-4422 (pinned-digest-fallback).
oncall-bot: oncall pager silence for 30m while we coordinate — escalation remains enabled.
liam: after pinning, we should add a small job to the release pipeline to verify cosign attestation for the pinned digest and attach an override in the deploybot if attestation missing. That avoids surprise later.
eva: agreed. I'll draft a short follow-up PR to add the verification job to the release pipeline.
sam: ok executing: maya, can you run the helm patch and trigger deploybot promote when ready? I'll be on standby to approve rollback if anything weird.
maya: running patch now. command: ```helm upgrade realtime ./charts/realtime -f values/prod.yaml --set image.digest=sha256:aa11...```
maya: promote submitted to deploybot. deploy-bot: promotion queued for redwood/realtime@sha256:aa11... targeting prod with canary=10%.
deploy-bot: promotion started. canary step: rollout to svc/realtime-prod-c1.
liam: monitoring logs and metrics. If 95th latency climbs > 200ms vs baseline, we abort and rollback to previous stable digest.
eva: I'll add the release note line: "Production deployed to redwood/realtime@sha256:aa11... (pinned due to manifest collision during push); follow-up reconciliation scheduled."
sam: nice, thanks. We'll run the reconciliation in staging tonight and if everything aligns we can consider issuing a new semantic tag that is re-attested.
maya: can anyone be on-call for the 10:15 verification step?
liam: I'll be there.
maya: last update: promotion completed canary=10% ok, canary=50% in progress.
oncall-bot: scheduled check-in reminder in 30m.
liam: 50% rollout looks stable. No errors in container startup.
maya: rolling to 100%. deploy-bot: promotion complete, prod pointing at redwood/realtime@sha256:aa11...
sam: marking the release notes and closing the immediate incident. Follow-up tickets: reconcile-manifests (INFR-4423), add-cosign-verifier (INFR-4424).
eva: thanks team. Lesson: add a short gating step to prevent concurrent publish from separate runners. I'll write up a short postmortem. :memo:
